summary: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited filed a 6-K with its 2026 proxy statement, seeking shareholder approval to issue shares for its proposed acquisition of CIBC Caribbean. The purchase price is $1.794 billion, representing 1.06x tangible book value and ~8.6x 2025 adjusted earnings. Consideration is ~61% cash and ~39% newly issued Butterfield shares, with about 11.58 million shares to CIBC. Existing shareholders would own 72.3%-75.2% of the enlarged group. The board unanimously recommends approval. Cash funding comes from existing resources and a subordinated debt offering with underwriting commitments. The transaction is expected to close pending shareholder and regulatory approvals.
